review.note: Retracted in M40b: Kennedy shot in Dallas on 22 November 1963. The Portuguese link would be American policy on the African territories — the vote against Portugal in the Security Council in 1961, and the renewal of the Azores base agreement used against it — and the atlas holds no record of either, so there is nothing here the death can be argued to have changed. It would need the Azores lease of 1962 as a record before the change of American tone after 1963 could be argued rather than asserted.
